title: 05329 - U102F/053295
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri, connections concerns or faulty G611-Radiator Identification Sensör Okuma Değerleri
stepByStepSolution: Correct wiring, connection concerns or Değiştirin / Yenileyin: failed G611-Radiator Identification Sensör Okuma Değerleri (w/radiator).
technicalNotes:
Currently, the G611-Radiator Identification Sensör Okuma Değerleri is not available separately, it comes with a new radiator when ordered from the vehicle's manufacture. The sensor will need to be attached to the radiator with AMV-195-KD1-01 adhesive, See Volkswagen Tech Tip 19-12-01 for more information.
